def top_terms(index: InvertedIndex, limit: int) -> List[str]:
    """Terms appearing in the most documents (document frequency, then alphabetical)."""
    ranked = sorted(index.postings, key=lambda t: (-len(index.postings[t]), t))
    return ranked[:limit]
